name: nchoosek
comment: Sig: r = nchoosek(N,K) scalar binomial; M = nchoosek(V,K) vector form -> all K-combinations of V, one per row, in lexicographic order of element indices. nchoosek([1 2 3 4],2)=[1 2;1 3;1 4;2 3;2 4;3 4] (6x2); values come from V not indices (nchoosek([10 20 30],2)=[10 20;10 30;20 30]). k==numel->single row, k==0->1x0. numkit previously threw on vector input; implemented 2026-05-29. Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09 + vector form.
